stem: A circle has radius ${=r}$ cm. Find the length of an arc of this circle whose measure is ${=m}^\circ$, in cm. Take $\pi=\frac{22}{7}$.
solution: The arc is the fraction $\frac{{=m}}{360}$ of the circle.
notes: No book question supplied; parent_question_id empty. r is a multiple of 7 and m a multiple of 90 so the answer is a whole number.
